summary: LG Display filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notification of its Q3 2026 earnings release conference call, scheduled for 14:00 KST on October 22, 2026, to be held by conference call in Korean and English. The notice, signed by Vice President Kyu Dong Kim of the Finance Risk Management Division, covers domestic and international institutional investors, individuals, analysts and media, with presentation materials to be posted on the IR website after disclosure. This is a routine earnings-calendar notice, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated. Watch for Q3 results and any guidance implications.
